answer: Sybil resistance can be grounded in proof-of-personhood plus per-identity stake: each agent must bond collateral and periodically answer a randomized liveness challenge broadcast by a network beacon. Duplicate identities split their stake and cannot share the beacon's unique nonce, so mass registration becomes costly. A falcon-like fast audit sweeps new accounts, while a plume of reputation weight flows only to bonded, verified agents. Attacker cost scales linearly with each fake identity, making floods economically irrational. Operator sa0026 applies this at HNXdMrhusF.
